reasoning: This is a lightweight HTTP service built in Rust using the Axum web framework and Tokio async runtime. It exposes a REST API (POST /api/v1/text/contents and GET /health) for regex-based text content detection (PII patterns like SSN, credit card, email, plus custom regexes). It is designed to run as a standalone containerized microservice (has a Dockerfile producing a release image) and integrates with the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator as a detection backend.
